description: This Java class 'ResponseHelper' provides utility methods to facilitate handling WebDAV responses, including creating XML elements like multistatus, response, status, and href, preparing responses with status codes, and writing XML responses to HTTP responses.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing and sending WebDAV XML responses, including creation of response elements and setting HTTP status.

methods.name: prepareResponse
methods.description: Sets the content type, character encoding, and status or error on the HttpServletResponse object.

methods.name: createElementSetValue
methods.description: Creates an XML element with a specific name in the DAV namespace and sets its text content.

methods.name: createHrefElement
methods.description: Creates a D:href XML element with the given URL.

methods.name: createMultiStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a multistatus XML element in the DAV namespace.

methods.name: createResponseDescriptionElement
methods.description: Creates a response description XML element with optional language attribute.

methods.name: createStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a status XML element with the given status text.

methods.name: getResponseDocument
methods.description: Returns the underlying XML Document object used to construct responses.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Serializes the XML document and writes it to the HttpServletResponse output.
